import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    if n == 0:
        print("0.0")
        return
    # Take next n integers
    arr = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    total = sum(arr)
    avg = total / n
    # Print as float
    print(avg)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
